title: 听力挑战 · 日常事务处理

rounds.speaker: 家人
rounds.line: Could you pick up the dry cleaning on your way back?
rounds.lineCn: 你回来的路上能顺便取一下干洗的衣服吗?

grammar.name: 短语动词 pick up
grammar.note: pick up 表示'取、领取',也可表示'捡起'、'顺路捎带'。

options.text: Sure, I will pick it up after work.
options.feedback: 答应请求,并准确使用 pick up 的取物义。

options.text: I dropped it off last Monday.
options.feedback: drop off 是'送去',与'取回'动作相反。

options.text: The cleaning was done by the store.
options.feedback: 被动句谈店里完成洗涤,没有答应取件。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: Have you looked into the insurance plan for the car yet?
rounds.lineCn: 你调查过车的保险方案了吗?

grammar.name: 短语动词 look into
grammar.note: look into 表示'调查、了解',与 look up '查阅'不同。

options.text: Not yet, but I will look into it tonight.
options.feedback: 如实回应并承诺调查,look into 使用准确。

options.text: I looked up the word in the dictionary.
options.feedback: look up 是'查词',与保险调查无关。

options.text: The plan is fully covered already.
options.feedback: 与'尚未调查'的现状矛盾。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: Can you put off the meeting to next Monday afternoon?
rounds.lineCn: 你能把会议推迟到下周一下午吗?

grammar.name: 短语动词 put off
grammar.note: put off 表示'推迟',相当于 postpone。

options.text: Sure, I will call everyone and tell them.
options.feedback: 答应推迟并安排通知,回应完整。

options.text: I put on my coat and left.
options.feedback: put on 是'穿上',与推迟会议无关。
与推迟会议的要求直接矛盾。
